description:
Welcome to **Toolbox Talk TV**, your trusted source for practical industrial safety training. We create easy-to-understand videos for workers, supervisors, HSE professionals, and safety students in oil & gas, petrochemical, fertilizer, chemical, manufacturing, and power industries.

Learn about Toolbox Talks, LMRA (Last Minute Risk Assessment), PPE, Permit to Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), confined space entry, working at height, fire watch, rigging and lifting, hazard identification, risk assessment, process safety, electrical safety, chemical safety, near miss reporting, emergency response, and more.

Every video is based on real workplace practices, industry standards, and lessons from real incidents to help improve safety awareness and prevent workplace accidents.

Subscribe for new industrial safety videos every week and build a safer workplace with Toolbox Talk TV.

#IndustrialSafety #HSE #ToolboxTalk #SafetyTraining #WorkplaceSafety #SafetyTalks
